highlights: Sign in to a site for your server's browser on this computer, for sites such as X that refuse a server sign-in.
Give an agent its own browser session, so two agents can use different accounts on the same site.
Agents move to a backup model on provider errors, and stuck OpenCode turns now end after 5 minutes.
Right-click a message to reply, copy, react or read it aloud, and duplicate a whole sidebar section.
Voice prompts and read-aloud replies now work on Linux.
